lab_name: Agentic MSP Support Agent Guided Lab
updated_by: Amit Kumar (prepared with the CloudLabs Lab Builder)
important_note: One seat = one TEAM environment (one CloudLabs deployment, used by the team's two identities, the Senior Technician and the Tier 1 Technician). Azure prices are Azure Retail Prices API list prices for swedencentral, USD, pay-as-you-go, retrieved 2026-10-01 (Purview meters 2026-10-02); no EA/CSP discount, reservation or free grant is applied (shared billing accounts are assumed to have used the Log Analytics 5 GB, Container Apps and semantic ranker free allowances). Microsoft 365 E5 is the published list price from July 1, 2026 (suite with Teams), charged per day for CEILING(D2/24)+1 days; if CloudLabs holds the licences by the month, use the monthly figure instead. Token rows are estimates for the 6-hour session (305 minutes of exercises) with heavy experimentation; the overage row covers up to three times that usage. Purview pay-as-you-go is billed to the Azure subscription linked to Purview in the lab tenant, not to the team resource group. The Power Apps Developer Plan is free but must be assigned to both team accounts; Microsoft licensing should confirm that one account per role per team is acceptable for this training delivery. Model quota: 30K TPM per team for gpt-5.4-mini and text-embedding-3-small, so 25 teams need 750K TPM of each in the subscription and region.

resources.name: Lab VM
resources.notes: Virtual Machines Dsv5 Series Windows, meter D4s v5, $0.388/hour x 730. Auto-shutdown at 00:00 UTC.

resources.name: Browser RDP container (CloudLabs)
resources.type_size: Azure Container Instances Linux, 1 vCPU, 1.5 GB
resources.notes: Standard vCPU Duration $0.0466/hour + Standard Memory Duration $0.00511/GB-hour x 1.5 = $0.054265/hour x 730.

resources.name: VM OS disk
resources.notes: Standard SSD Managed Disks, meter E10 LRS Disk, $9.60/month; operations ($0.002 per 10K) negligible.

resources.name: Public IP address
resources.notes: IP Addresses, meter Standard IPv4 Static Public IP, $0.005/hour x 730.

resources.name: Azure AI Search
resources.type_size: Basic, 1 search unit, semantic ranker free plan
resources.notes: Azure AI Search, meter Basic Unit, $0.101/hour x 730. Fixed: about 400 semantic ranker queries at $1 per 1K (Semantic Ranker queries meter).

resources.name: Azure API Management
resources.notes: API Management, meter Basic v2 Unit, $0.27/hour x 730. Fixed: under 10K calls at the Basic v2 Calls meter ($0.04 per 10K).

resources.name: Azure Container Apps (MCP server)
resources.type_size: Consumption, 0.5 vCPU / 1 GiB, 1 replica always on
resources.notes: Standard vCPU Active Usage $0.000024/s x 0.5 + Standard Memory Active Usage $0.000003/GiB-s, x 3600 x 730. Conservative: billed at active rates (idle rate would be about $11.83/month). Consumption-only environment: no Environment Management Hour charge.

resources.name: Azure Container Registry
resources.notes: Container Registry, meter Basic Registry Unit, $0.1666/day x 30.4167. Fixed: about 6 ACR Tasks builds x 4 minutes (provisioning, Exercise 3 and Exercise 4) at $0.0001 per task-second (the API shows the first 6,000 seconds at $0).

resources.name: Azure Key Vault
resources.notes: Key Vault, meter Operations, $0.03 per 10K operations; a few thousand secret reads and metadata reads.

resources.name: Log Analytics workspace (incl. workspace-based Application Insights)
resources.notes: Analytics Logs Data Ingestion $2.99/GB above the free 5 GB (assumed consumed in a shared billing account); about 0.3 GB per team of API Management, Container Apps, Key Vault audit and agent trace data, including captured agent content. Retention within the included 31 days.

resources.name: Microsoft Foundry: gpt-5.4-mini
resources.notes: Azure OpenAI GPT5 meters 5.4 mini Inp Gl $0.75/1M, 5.4 mini Opt Gl $4.50/1M. Estimate per team: 5M input + 0.5M output tokens (about 120 user turns and 350 model calls with retrieval and tool results over 305 minutes of exercises).

resources.name: Microsoft Foundry: text-embedding-3-small
resources.notes: Meter text-embedding-3-small-glbl Tokens, $0.00002 per 1K. Two loads of the 561-document index (about 150K tokens each) plus query vectors.

resources.name: Microsoft Foundry Agent Service
resources.type_size: Prompt agent with Azure AI Search and MCP tools
resources.notes: No charge for creating or running prompt agents; the tools bill through their own resources (rows above).

resources.name: Microsoft Purview pay-as-you-go (data security for AI interactions)
resources.type_size: processContent DLP verdicts and audit records
resources.notes: Microsoft Purview Data Security, meter In Transit Protection Request, $0.00005 per request ($0.50 per 10K): about 500 processContent requests per team. Microsoft Purview Data Compliance, meter Audit Standard Asset, $0.015 per 1K audit records: about 1,000 records. Billed to the subscription linked to Purview pay-as-you-go.

resources.name: Power Platform developer environment (Dataverse)
resources.type_size: Developer environment, up to 2 GB Dataverse
resources.notes: Included with the Power Apps Developer Plan; does not consume tenant Dataverse capacity. Remove after the event (not deleted with the resource group).

resources.name: Overage: heavier model usage
resources.type_size: gpt-5.4-mini up to 3x the base estimate
resources.notes: Covers teams that experiment far beyond the guide (up to about 15M input and 1.5M output tokens). Excluded from the base total.

duration_details.breakdown: Launched the afternoon before the session so provisioning (about 60 to 90 minutes), the readiness check and the first log data (up to 90 minutes) are complete, with time to re-provision any team that is not ready
15 min sign-in and readiness + 305 min of exercises + three 10-min breaks + 10 min close
Time before CloudLabs deletes the resource group
1.5 hours provisioning and checks + 6-hour session + 1.5 hours buffer; the VM is auto-shut down overnight
CEILING(24/24)+1, covering the evening of provisioning and the session day
